newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hylsamex swallows energy hike, sees margins toll.
newsitem.headline: Hylsamex swallows energy hike, sees margins toll.

text.p: Higher energy costs for Hylsamex, Mexican steel maker and subsidiary of conglomerate Alfa, will take a toll on margins, but will be "manageable," a top company official told Reuters.

"The effect depends on how intensive our use of energy is. In our case, I would say (the impact) is manageable, although this does not mean it is not considerable," the official said, asking not to be named.

Last week, state-owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) raised fuel prices almost 50 percent and natural gas prices 47.4 percent. The company said in a statement the increase corresponded to a rise in international energy prices.
"Yes, it affects us because from 16 to 17 percent of our cost structure is tied to energy. The impact on our margins will follow in the same proportion," the Hylsamex official said.
